name: Son La
provinceNote: Sơn La province. From 1 July 2025 the town center is phường Tô Hiệu.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: The valley town under Khau Ca, prison walls above the Nam La, on Highway 6 past Moc Chau. Stay if that night is the trip. Sleep in Moc Chau if you wanted the tea morning, and do not drive on to Dien Bien the same day. Prison clocks and tickets do not agree, so check the gate on arrival.
timeNeeded: One night, or two if the dam is next
getThere: Highway 6 past Moc Chau. Hanoi is 293 km, about 300 km, or more than 300 km.
seoTitle: Son La travel guide — Highway 6 valley past Moc Chau
seoDescription: Sleep under Khau Ca, the valley town west of the Moc Chau tea plateau on Highway 6. Dry months are October to April. Prison hours and the dam distance disagree.
intro: The stone walls stand on Khau Ca, and the town and the Nam La sit in the bowl under them. The ridges close the valley behind the hill. Stay if that night is the trip. Sleep in Moc Chau if you wanted the tea rows on the plateau before this city. Do not drive on to Dien Bien the same day when the hill over the town is the reason you stopped.

The bed is a small hotel or guesthouse in the town center. From 1 July 2025 that center is phường Tô Hiệu, the old Chiềng Lề market street. The other bed is a Thái stilt house at Bản Mòng, xã Hua La, on the edge of the city. A May 2025 walking-street notice still prints thành phố Sơn La and the wards Chiềng Cơi and Quyết Thắng. A May 2026 line prints phường Chiềng Cơi, tỉnh Sơn La, without the words thành phố. The 2020 handbook still prints thành phố Sơn La. Two Saturday nights a month, Hoàng Quốc Việt is a walking street from 19:30 to 23:00, from the Highway 6 junction to the turn into bản Mé Ban. Which two Saturdays in a given month are check on arrival. On the other nights the evening address is check on arrival.

Give the morning to the central market, then the climb to Khau Ca for the prison and the museum beside it. About one hour for the prison and about one hour for the museum, on one split. Late afternoon, the Lê Thái Tông temple looks back over the stream. Bản Mòng is the other half of the day, or the night in the stilt house. The dam on the Đà is a separate morning, north on Highway 279. The mistake is treating the museum ticket and the relic ticket as one price, or budgeting the whole day for a hill that sits in town.
gettingAround: The usual start is Hanoi, and the road is National Highway 6. The 2020 handbook says more than 300 km. The prison page says about 300 km. The 2026 coach decision prints 300 km to Mỹ Đình and 293 km to Yên Nghĩa, two different Hanoi stations. The 2020 handbook’s overnight coach leaves Mỹ Đình about 19:00–20:00 and reaches Sơn La about 7:00–8:00, about 7–8 hours. A reservoir page also prints a coach of 7–8 hours, and a car of 6–7 hours for the road through this city and on to Mường La, which is not a pure city-center time. The 2026 decision lists clocks and prints no duration, so it does not replace those older hours. The fare is check on arrival.

Departures listed from Sơn La on that 2026 decision are 5:45, 8:15, 20:30, 22:15, and 23:30. Return clocks from Mỹ Đình are 18:30, 23:45, 12:45, 20:00, and 16:00. The operator is Công ty cổ phần vận tải hành khách 2-9 Sơn La. The decision is 166/QĐ-SXD of 29 April 2026. Điện Biên coaches also pass the city and often arrive at night, on the 2020 handbook.

The maintained Highway 6 section Km193+000–Km303+000 is 110 km, described in 2017 as huyện Mộc Châu to thành phố Sơn La. That is a project length, not the drive from town to town. Two commercial pages put the center-to-center drive at about 140 km and at more than 140 km, with about 3 hours or more than 3 hours by car and about 5 hours or nearly 5 hours by motorbike. A road-authority minute count for this leg is check on arrival. The 2017 chairman’s line, that the upgrade cut Hòa Bình–Sơn La time by nearly one hour, is not a 2026 minute count.

Noi Bai in Hanoi is the airport travelers actually use. The handbook sends southern visitors to Hanoi by air and then by road. Nà Sản, in xã Chiềng Mung and Mai Sơn, is in the national airport plan and is not a 2026 passenger service. Do not book a flight into it. No rail station is named for this city.

In town, Highway 6 is the street the coaches use through the valley. Highway 279 leaves north for Mường La and the dam. The prison is a walk up Khau Ca from the center. A taxi fare inside town, a city bus map, and a motorbike hire price are check on arrival. Bản Mòng is a paved road to Hua La. The commune page says nearly 6 km, the national tourism desk about 5 km, and the handbook and a tourism-organization page about 7 km. Minutes on that road are check on arrival.

West, Highway 6 climbs Pha Đin toward Điện Biên. The pass itself is 32 km on both pages that measure it. The Điện Biên relic board says the pass starts 66 km west of Sơn La town and ends about 84 km from Điện Biên city, at more than 1,000 m. Another page prints a summit of 1,648 m, 65 km from Sơn La, and 80 km from Điện Biên Phủ. The height is more than 1,000 m on one page and 1,648 m on the other. Minutes are check on arrival. Yên Châu is the district town on this highway between Mộc Châu and the city. Kilometers for Yên Châu are check on arrival. Hòa Bình is the city on the coach road toward Hanoi. Minutes from here are check on arrival. Mai Châu is the valley before the plateau. A kilometer from this city was not printed, so that leg is check on arrival. Tà Xùa is a cloud ridge in the province. The road from this city is check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: Town center
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels and guesthouses on the old Chiềng Lề market street, inside phường Tô Hiệu from 1 July 2025. This is the bed under Khau Ca, a walk from the hill. No hotel brand is named. A room rate is check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: Ban Mong
stayAreas.summary: Thái stilt houses at Bản Mòng, xã Hua La, on the edge of the city. The spring Bó Nặm Ún and the lane are the reason to sleep here. The distance is about 5 km, nearly 6 km, or about 7 km, depending on the page. The commune page says the water is a stable 36–38°C and that people come in any month. The national tourism desk says the outdoor average is 38°C and that the water is milder in summer and hotter in winter. A room rate and a soak price are check on arrival.

eat: The meal is pa pỉnh tộp, hearth-smoked buffalo, cơm lam, xôi ngũ sắc, and rượu cần, at Bản Mòng or in town. Báo Sơn La also names măng bói at the city market and chẩm chéo as the dip. Chợ Trung tâm is the morning hall on the old Chiềng Lề street, 8,940 m² in the 2024 list, now inside phường Tô Hiệu. The clock is Check on arrival.
interestsBody: The meal is the Thái hearth at Bản Mòng or in town: the fish, the smoked buffalo, the bamboo tube, the five-color rice, and the jar.
The prison on Khau Ca is the morning in town. The Đà River dam is the half-day north, with two distances and two visit rules.

cards.title: The prison on Khau Ca
cards.summary: Walk the French prison on the hill. The clocks and the tickets do not agree.

body: The prison stands on Khau Ca, in phường Tô Hiệu after 1 July 2025. You walk stone walls, four watchtowers, ground-floor and underground cells, a cistern, the cemetery and Tô Hiệu’s grave, and the peach tree he planted. Much of the original building is a ruin after the bombings of 1952 and 1965. It was ranked a special national relic on 31 December 2014. Morning is the easier hour. Around Tết the peach is the picture, and that week is check on arrival.

GoVietnam prints about 7:30–17:30 with a midday break. Mytour prints 7:30–18:30. A museum page prints 7:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:30. The relic pages print 30,000, 15,000, and 5,000 VND, and they do not describe the 15,000 VND line the same way. The museum page prints 10,000 VND from age 16, 5,000 VND from 10 to under 16, and free under 10. The gate on the day is check on arrival. The museum beside the prison is the same walk. The handbook says more than 1,000 ancient Thái and Dao books. A travel page says more than 23,000 objects.

body: The plant is at Ít Ong, Mường La, on the Đà. EVN inaugurated it on 23 December 2012. Capacity is 2,400 MW. The handbook and a reservoir page put it about 40 km and about one hour north of the city. sonlatour.vn prints about 60 km. The reservoir page says the outside view is free and the plant below the dam is closed. A 2026 note says register ahead, about 2–3 hours, free or very low. A current gate tariff is check on arrival.

Pá Uôn is the bridge farther along the reservoir road, after Mường La. The handbook says 105 m from the ground to the deck and a middle span of 120 m. The reservoir page says the deck is 100 m above the lake and the bridge is 918 m long, about 60 km northwest of the dam. Those heights are not one measurement. A bridge ticket was not printed. The lakeside temples at Quỳnh Nhai are a different stop: a first-month incense ground, with a 32 m Quan Âm finished at the end of 2020. A time and a fee there are check on arrival.

faqs.a: Moc Chau is the tea plateau on Highway 6 before this city. Son La is the valley town after it, under Khau Ca. A tea-row morning is the plateau. The prison hill over the Nam La is this night.

faqs.q: How long is the road from Hanoi?
faqs.a: The handbook says more than 300 km. The prison page says about 300 km. The 2026 coach decision prints 300 km to Mỹ Đình and 293 km to Yên Nghĩa. The 2020 overnight run is about 7–8 hours. A reservoir page also prints a coach of 7–8 hours, and a car of 6–7 hours on the road that continues to the dam. The 2026 decision prints clocks and no duration. The fare is check on arrival.

faqs.q: What time does the prison open, and what is the ticket?
faqs.a: GoVietnam prints about 7:30–17:30 with a midday break. Mytour prints 7:30–18:30. A museum page prints 7:30–11:30 and 13:30–17:30. GoVietnam and Mytour print 30,000 VND, 15,000 VND, and 5,000 VND, and they do not describe the 15,000 VND line the same way. The museum page prints 10,000 VND from age 16, 5,000 VND from 10 to under 16, and free under 10. The gate on the day is check on arrival.

faqs.q: When is the Le temple festival?
faqs.a: One festival page prints 15–17 of the first lunar month. Another prints 15–17 in the header and 22–24 of the first lunar month in the body. The first city edition, on that second page, fell on 15–17 of the first lunar month in 2016. The civil dates for 2027 are check on arrival. The fee is check on arrival.

season.label: Dry road from October to April
season.note: A reservoir page calls October–April the dry months and May–September the rain, and it prints 10–18°C for November–January at the lake. That temperature is one page, not a city weather station. The same publisher’s pass page names thick fog on Pha Đin in December–February and tells drivers to avoid June–August rain. A pass-closure calendar is check on arrival. The Tô Hiệu peach flowers around Tết, and the civil dates move. The Lê temple gathering is 15–17 or 22–24 of the first lunar month, and the 2027 dates are check on arrival. The 2020 handbook names September for Hmong independence days and does not name a day.
